sloka: नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः प्रभिन्नैः सलिलाशयैः ।ताम्रैः किसलयैः क्लान्तैः क्लान्तद्रुमलतायुतम् ।न बभौ तद्वनं तत्र दावानलहतं यथा ।। ५.४१.१७।।।।
transliteration: nānāśakuntavirutaiḥ prabhinnaiḥ salilāśayaiḥ ।tāmraiḥ kisalayaiḥ klāntaiḥ klāntadrumalatāyutam ।na babhau tadvanaṁ tatra dāvānalahataṁ yathā ।। 5.41.17।।।।

translations.english: Vines and trees wilted, birds shrieking, the embankments of ponds destroyed, its tender coppery red shoots withered, the garden looked as though it is burnt by forest fire and the climbers looked like women shivering in fear with their robes disarrayed.
